target.consumer: universal cognitive swarm canary and stress verifier

problem: The completed lease/retry canary has a post-build critic NO_SHIP boundary: retryability can be bypassed, overlap proof can collapse unknown into empty, stale generations have no deterministic recovery fence, recovery-attempt creation can count as liveness before STARTED/heartbeat, and generated recovery claim shape diverges from persisted recovery-claim evidence.
acceptance: Retry safety cannot be bypassed when retryable is false.
Overlap proof is tri-state and UNKNOWN cannot become NO_ACTIVE_OVERLAP.
Exactly one recovery worker can acquire a deterministic fence per stale generation.
Recovery attempts do not count as worker liveness until STARTED or heartbeat.
Generated recovery claim schema is compatible with persisted opportunity recovery claims.
Existing claims, attempts, returns and late-return evidence remain append-only and preserved.
No global Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion is performed by this follow-up.
title: Harden lease/retry recovery fencing
mission: Patch the existing lease/retry primitives narrowly so stale recovery is retry-proof, overlap-proof, generation-fenced and schema-compatible, while preserving prior evidence and keeping promotion authority out of the worker lane.

goal_relevance.reason: Recovery correctness is part of the universal-worker canary contract and is required before broad stress/readiness evidence can be trusted.

information_gain.reason: The follow-up converts five critic findings into falsifiable recovery invariants rather than relying on chat-local coordination behavior.

regression_prevention.reason: The original build already has an 11-case suite; a narrow follow-up can add explicit negative tests for retry bypass, UNKNOWN overlap, generation races, pre-run liveness and schema compatibility without rebuilding the subsystem.

human_friction_reduction.reason: A deterministic recovery fence prevents multiple fresh chats from converging on the same stale generation and removes manual arbitration from the human path.

falsification: retryable=false can still produce a recovery candidate.
UNKNOWN overlap evidence is treated as no active overlap.
Two workers can acquire distinct recovery attempts for the same stale generation without one losing a deterministic fence.
A recovery claim with no STARTED run or heartbeat resets liveness age.
Generated recovery-claim payload cannot be persisted without schema adaptation.
The patch rewrites or suppresses prior claim/run/return evidence.
dedup_note: The recovery critic already identified these defects; this proposal does not claim a new defect discovery. It pins the critic-requested implementation follow-up as one deduplicated candidate under the existing Lease/Retry owner instead of opening a competing subsystem or recovery attempt.
